summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K as a foreign private issuer, commencing a public offering of R$1 billion in unsecured, non-convertible simple debentures under Brazil's automatic registration procedure (CVM Resolution 160). The terms are standard for a debt issuance: one million debentures at R$1,000 each, with a brAAA rating by S&P and BTG Pactual as lead coordinator. No equity, merger, or special-situation event is involved. This is a routine capital markets debt financing, equivalent to a US shelf takedown notice. Nothing to watch or arbitrage.
